# connect

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

open suspend fun [connect](connect.html)(request: [LlmRequest](../-llm-request/index.html)): [LiveConnection](../-live-connection/index.html)

Opens a live (bidirectional streaming) connection, configured by [LlmRequest.liveConnectConfig](../-llm-request/live-connect-config.html).

The returned connection is open but not yet primed; send history or content to start the conversation, and close it when it ends.

#### Parameters

 _request_

The request whose live config, model name, system instruction and tools configure the session.

#### Throws

[UnsupportedOperationException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unsupported-operation-exception/index.html)

if this model does not support live connections.

# CacheMetadata

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [CacheMetadata](index.html)(val fingerprint: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val contentsCount: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html), val cacheName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val expireTime: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null, val invocationsUsed: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)? = null, val createdAt: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null)

Metadata for the context cache associated with LLM responses.

This stores cache identification, usage tracking, and lifecycle information for a particular cache instance. It can be in one of two states:

  1. **Active cache state:** [cacheName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) is set and [expireTime](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html), [invocationsUsed](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html), and [createdAt](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) are populated.

  2. **Fingerprint-only state:** [cacheName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) is `null` and only [fingerprint](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) and [contentsCount](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.models/-cache-metadata/--root--.html) are set, used for prefix matching before a cache exists.




Token counts (cached and total) are available in [LlmResponse.usageMetadata](../-llm-response/usage-metadata.html) and should be accessed from there to avoid duplication.

# RealtimeInput

common

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

sealed interface [RealtimeInput](index.html) : [LiveInput](../-live-input/index.html)

Input streamed to a live model outside the turn-by-turn content exchange.

Realtime input is not a turn: media streams in continuously and the model decides when the user has finished, unless activity detection is disabled and the caller marks the boundaries with [ActivityStart](-activity-start/index.html) and [ActivityEnd](-activity-end/index.html); realtime _text_ has no arm here and is sent as content.

[Audio](-audio/index.html) and [Video](-video/index.html) are separate arms because the Kotlin GenAI SDK has no combined media parameter, so the caller chooses which it is sending.

#### Inheritors

[Audio](-audio/index.html)

[Video](-video/index.html)

[ActivityStart](-activity-start/index.html)

[ActivityEnd](-activity-end/index.html)

[AudioStreamEnd](-audio-stream-end/index.html)

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

enum [EndSensitivity](index.html) : [Enum](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-enum/index.html)<[EndSensitivity](index.html)>

How readily the model treats a pause as the end of speech.

MembersEntries

## Entries

[END_SENSITIVITY_UNSPECIFIED](-e-n-d_-s-e-n-s-i-t-i-v-i-t-y_-u-n-s-p-e-c-i-f-i-e-d/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[END_SENSITIVITY_HIGH](-e-n-d_-s-e-n-s-i-t-i-v-i-t-y_-h-i-g-h/index.html)

Speech is ended more often, so the model responds sooner.

[END_SENSITIVITY_LOW](-e-n-d_-s-e-n-s-i-t-i-v-i-t-y_-l-o-w/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[END_SENSITIVITY_LOW](-e-n-d_-s-e-n-s-i-t-i-v-i-t-y_-l-o-w/index.html)

Speech is ended less often, so longer gaps are tolerated mid-turn.

# ToolResponse

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [ToolResponse](index.html)(val id: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val toolType: [ToolType](../-tool-type/index.html)? = null, val response: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>? = null)

The output of a server-side [ToolCall](../-tool-call/index.html) the model ran itself.

Echoed back on the next request alongside its [ToolCall](../-tool-call/index.html), or the model redoes the work it already did, or fails because a call has no matching response.

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

@[JvmInline](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-inline/index.html)

value class [ToolType](index.html)(val value: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html))

The type of tool a server-side [ToolCall](../-tool-call/index.html) invoked.

A value class rather than an enum so a type the model adds later round-trips unchanged instead of failing to parse.

# ToolCall

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [ToolCall](index.html)(val id: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val toolType: [ToolType](../-tool-type/index.html)? = null, val args: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>? = null)

A tool call the model runs on its own server side.

The client does not execute this call; it echoes the part back on the next request together with the matching [ToolResponse](../-tool-response/index.html), or the model redoes the work it already did.

# TurnCompleteReason

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)(with = [TurnCompleteReasonSerializer::class](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-turn-complete-reason-serializer/index.html))

enum [TurnCompleteReason](index.html) : [Enum](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-enum/index.html)<[TurnCompleteReason](index.html)>

Why a live turn ended.

Absent on an ordinary completion; present when the turn was cut short, most often by a safety filter on either the input or the generated content.

MembersEntries

fun [valueOf](value-of.html)(value: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)): [TurnCompleteReason](index.html)

Returns the enum constant of this type with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this type. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)

# ReplicatedVoiceConfig

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [ReplicatedVoiceConfig](index.html)(val mimeType: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val voiceSampleAudio: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val consentAudio: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val voiceConsentSignature: [VoiceConsentSignature](../-voice-consent-signature/index.html)? = null)

Configuration for a replicated (cloned) voice.

Either [consentAudio](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-replicated-voice-config/--root--.html) or a previously issued [voiceConsentSignature](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-replicated-voice-config/--root--.html) must accompany the sample; the signature avoids re-verifying the same consent on every request.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.types](../index.html)/InteractionStatus

# InteractionStatus

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)(with = [InteractionStatusSerializer::class](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-interaction-status-serializer/index.html))

enum [InteractionStatus](index.html) : [Enum](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-enum/index.html)<[InteractionStatus](index.html)>

Whether the model is still working on the user's prompt.

A newer live model may answer one prompt with several turns, so a completed turn alone does not mean the model is done. Only [IN_PROGRESS](-i-n_-p-r-o-g-r-e-s-s/index.html) on a completed turn means more output for this prompt will follow.

MembersEntries

## Entries

[INTERACTION_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED](-i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n_-s-t-a-t-u-s_-u-n-s-p-e-c-i-f-i-e-d/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[INTERACTION_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED](-i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n_-s-t-a-t-u-s_-u-n-s-p-e-c-i-f-i-e-d/index.html)

Unspecified, or a status this version of ADK does not recognize.

[IN_PROGRESS](-i-n_-p-r-o-g-r-e-s-s/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[IN_PROGRESS](-i-n_-p-r-o-g-r-e-s-s/index.html)

More output may follow: the model is still processing input or reasoning in the background.

[REQUIRES_ACTION](-r-e-q-u-i-r-e-s_-a-c-t-i-o-n/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[REQUIRES_ACTION](-r-e-q-u-i-r-e-s_-a-c-t-i-o-n/index.html)

Deprecated by the service in favor of [IDLE](-i-d-l-e/index.html), and means the same.

[IDLE](-i-d-l-e/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[IDLE](-i-d-l-e/index.html)

The model has finished processing the prompt and is waiting for user input.

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [Transcription](index.html)(val text: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val finished: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val languageCode: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val speakerLabel: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val words: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[WordInfo](../-word-info/index.html)>? = null)

A transcription of audio, either the user's input or the model's output.

Transcriptions arrive in chunks: each carries the newest text, and [finished](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-transcription/--root--.html) marks the last chunk of an utterance.

# WordInfo

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [WordInfo](index.html)(val word: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val startOffset: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val endOffset: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null)

# AudioTranscriptionConfigMode

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

enum [AudioTranscriptionConfigMode](index.html) : [Enum](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-enum/index.html)<[AudioTranscriptionConfigMode](index.html)>

How [AudioTranscriptionConfig](../-audio-transcription-config/index.html) transcribes speech; defaults to [VERBATIM](-v-e-r-b-a-t-i-m/index.html) when unspecified.

MembersEntries

## Entries

[MODE_UNSPECIFIED](-m-o-d-e_-u-n-s-p-e-c-i-f-i-e-d/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[MODE_UNSPECIFIED](-m-o-d-e_-u-n-s-p-e-c-i-f-i-e-d/index.html)

Leaves the mode unspecified, which defaults to [VERBATIM](-v-e-r-b-a-t-i-m/index.html).

[VERBATIM](-v-e-r-b-a-t-i-m/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[VERBATIM](-v-e-r-b-a-t-i-m/index.html)

Transcribes speech as spoken.

[SMART](-s-m-a-r-t/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

[SMART](-s-m-a-r-t/index.html)

Removes disfluencies (filler words, repetitions, and false starts), cleans up grammar, formats paragraphs and lists, and applies inline self-corrections. Incompatible with [AudioTranscriptionConfig.wordTimestamp](../-audio-transcription-config/word-timestamp.html) and [AudioTranscriptionConfig.diarization](../-audio-transcription-config/diarization.html).

## Properties

[entries](entries.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

# SMART

common

[SMART](index.html)

Removes disfluencies (filler words, repetitions, and false starts), cleans up grammar, formats paragraphs and lists, and applies inline self-corrections. Incompatible with [AudioTranscriptionConfig.wordTimestamp](../../-audio-transcription-config/word-timestamp.html) and [AudioTranscriptionConfig.diarization](../../-audio-transcription-config/diarization.html).

# PartialArg

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [PartialArg](index.html)(val value: [PartialArgValue](../-partial-arg-value/index.html)? = null, val jsonPath: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val willContinue: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null)

Partial argument value of the function call.

The value of the partial argument is represented by [value](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-partial-arg/--root--.html), which uses [PartialArgValue](../-partial-arg-value/index.html) to ensure that only one of boolean, number, string, or null is represented at a time.

# PartialArgValue

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

sealed interface [PartialArgValue](index.html)

Represents one of the possible values within a [PartialArg](../-partial-arg/index.html).

This sealed interface ensures that only one value type (boolean, number, string, or null) can be represented at a time.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.types](../index.html)/LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate

# LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate](index.html)(val newHandle: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val resumable: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val lastConsumedClientMessageIndex: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null)

A handle for resuming this session on a later connection.

Sent only when session resumption is requested. The handle arrives at points of the server's choosing, including after a turn has completed, so a reader that stops at the end of a turn can miss it.

Members

## Constructors

[LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate](-live-server-session-resumption-update.html)

common

## Properties

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [lastConsumedClientMessageIndex](last-consumed-client-message-index.html): [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)?

Index of the last client message the server processed, sent only for a transparent session, so a reconnect can replay from that point.

[resumable](resumable.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

# SessionResumptionConfig

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [SessionResumptionConfig](index.html)(val handle: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val transparent: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null)

Configures the session resumption mechanism.

Setting this asks the server to send session resumption updates over the connection.

Members

common

val [handle](handle.html): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)?

Resumption handle of a previous session to restore. If absent, a new session is started.

[transparent](transparent.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [transparent](transparent.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)?

Whether the server should report the last consumed client message index, so a reconnect can resume without replaying. Only honored on the Vertex backend; Gemini API clients reject it.

common

* * *

Sets [startOffset](../../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-video-metadata/-builder/start-offset.html) in milliseconds, or clears it when `null`. The non-null overload remains for binary compatibility and so Java `int` literals still compile.

# Part

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

class [Part](index.html)(val text: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val inlineData: [Blob](../-blob/index.html)? = null, val fileData: [FileData](../-file-data/index.html)? = null, val functionCall: [FunctionCall](../-function-call/index.html)? = null, val functionResponse: [FunctionResponse](../-function-response/index.html)? = null, val thought: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val thoughtSignature: [ByteArray](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-byte-array/index.html)? = null, val videoMetadata: [VideoMetadata](../-video-metadata/index.html)? = null, val toolCall: [ToolCall](../-tool-call/index.html)? = null, val toolResponse: [ToolResponse](../-tool-response/index.html)? = null, val partMetadata: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>? = null, val executableCode: [ExecutableCode](../-executable-code/index.html)? = null, val codeExecutionResult: [CodeExecutionResult](../-code-execution-result/index.html)? = null, val mediaResolution: [PartMediaResolution](../-part-media-resolution/index.html)? = null)

A part of a multi-modal prompt or response.

A Part can contain one of the following:

  * text: Plain text.

  * inlineData: Binary data (e.g., image, audio).

  * fileData: Data from a file.

  * functionCall: A call to a function.

  * functionResponse: The response from a function call.

  * toolCall: A tool call the model ran on its own server side.

  * toolResponse: The output of a server-side tool call.

  * executableCode: Code generated by the model to be executed.

  * codeExecutionResult: The result of executing an executableCode part.

# HttpOptions

common

data class [HttpOptions](index.html)(val baseUrl: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val apiVersion: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val headers: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)>? = null, val timeout: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html)? = null)

ADK-owned HTTP transport options for calls a [com.google.adk.kt.models.Model](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-model/index.html) makes to its backend.

This is ADK's own type rather than the backend SDK's, so that configuration surfaces such as [com.google.adk.kt.agents.ContextCacheConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context-cache-config/index.html) stay independent of any particular backend. Implementations translate it to whatever their transport expects.

# ContextCacheConfig

common

data class [ContextCacheConfig](index.html) @[ExperimentalContextCachingFeature](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-context-caching-feature/index.html) constructor(val cacheIntervals: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html) = 10, val ttl: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html) = 1800.seconds, val minTokens: [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html) = 0, val createHttpOptions: [HttpOptions](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-http-options/index.html)? = null)

Configuration for context caching across all agents in an app.

When this config is present on an app, context caching is enabled for all agents. When absent (`null`), context caching is disabled.

Context caching can significantly reduce costs and improve response times by reusing previously processed context across multiple requests.

Constructing this type requires `@OptIn(ExperimentalContextCachingFeature::class)`.

common

val [cacheIntervals](cache-intervals.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)

Maximum number of invocations to reuse the same cache before refreshing it. Must be in the range `1..100`. Defaults to 10.

[createHttpOptions](create-http-options.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [createHttpOptions](create-http-options.html): [HttpOptions](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-http-options/index.html)?

Optional HTTP options for the cache-creation call. Set this to add a timeout on `CachedContent.create()` calls (e.g. `HttpOptions(timeout = 10.seconds)`). When the cache creation call exceeds the timeout, it fails and the request proceeds without caching. `null` uses the model backend's default HTTP options.

[minTokens](min-tokens.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [minTokens](min-tokens.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)

Minimum prior-request tokens required to enable caching. This gates on the previous request's actual prompt token count (from the model's usage metadata), not an estimate of the current request. Gemini enforces a hard 4096-token minimum that always applies, so values below 4096 have no additional effect. No cache is created on the first request of a session; caching begins on the second turn once a previous token count is known. Context cache storage may have a cost, so set this higher to avoid caching small requests where the overhead may exceed the benefits. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

[ttl](ttl.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [ttl](ttl.html): [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html)

Time-to-live for the cache. Must be strictly positive. Defaults to 30 minutes.

[ttlString](ttl-string.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [ttlString](ttl-string.html): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)

Returns the TTL in the string format used for cache creation, e.g. `"1800s"`.

# call

common

abstract suspend fun [call](call.html)(context: [ToolContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-tool-context/index.html), tool: [BaseTool](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-base-tool/index.html), args: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>, result: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>): [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>

Callback executed after a tool runs, or after a before-tool callback answers the call in its place.

This callback allows for inspecting, logging, or modifying the tool result.

#### Return

The potentially updated or replaced dictionary / map to propagate downstream.

#### Parameters

 _context_

The context specific to the tool execution.

_tool_

The tool for the call; for a name that matches no registered tool, a placeholder carrying that name.

_args_

The arguments for the tool call, including any changes from before-tool callbacks.

_result_

The tool's result as a map, or the result a before-tool or on-tool-error callback supplied instead. Values may be `null`.

# ToolContext

common

class [ToolContext](index.html)(invocationContext: [InvocationContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-invocation-context/index.html), actions: [EventActions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html) = EventActions(), functionCallId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, toolConfirmation: [ToolConfirmation](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-tool-confirmation/index.html)? = null, eventId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null) : [Context](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/index.html)

Context passed to tool executions.

This subclass is kept for backward compatibility. Prefer [Context](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/index.html) in new code.

A tool context is not a node activation, so the node-only members inherited from [Context](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/index.html) (such as [Context.output](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/output.html) and [Context.routes](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/routes.html)) throw [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html) here.

# Context

common

open class [Context](index.html)(val invocationContext: [InvocationContext](../-invocation-context/index.html), actions: [EventActions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html)? = null, val functionCallId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val toolConfirmation: [ToolConfirmation](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-tool-confirmation/index.html)? = null, val eventId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null) : [ReadonlyContext](../-readonly-context/index.html), [ReadonlyToolContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-readonly-tool-context/index.html)

Execution context passed to agent callbacks, model callbacks, tools, and workflow nodes during an invocation.

Provides read access to invocation metadata and session state, along with methods to record state deltas, artifacts, and control-flow signals. Tool-specific operations such as [requestConfirmation](request-confirmation.html) require a [functionCallId](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/--root--.html), which is only populated during a tool call. The node-only members (such as [output](output.html) and [routes](routes.html)) throw [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html) unless this context was created for a workflow node; a callback, model-callback, or tool context is not a node activation and so has none of them.

A context is created in one of two ways: the public constructor is used for callbacks and tools, while the internal constructor is used for workflow node activations. Only the internal constructor populates node execution state (such as [node](node.html) and [parent](parent.html)); contexts created with the public constructor leave that state empty, causing node-only members to throw.

[CallbackContext](../-callback-context/index.html) and [com.google.adk.kt.tools.ToolContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-tool-context/index.html) are thin subclasses kept for backward compatibility. Prefer [Context](index.html) in new code.

This class is `open` only so those two subclasses can exist as distinct JVM types that Java callers can reference. Every member is `final` so subclasses only forward constructor arguments without changing behavior.

#### Inheritors

[ToolContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-tool-context/index.html)

annotation class [AdkJavaInteropApi](-adk-java-interop-api/index.html)

Marks an API that exists only to make ADK usable from Java, such as the fluent builders. Kotlin callers should use the primary constructor and named arguments instead; opting in acknowledges that you specifically need the Java-facing surface. Java callers are unaffected, since the opt-in requirement is enforced only by the Kotlin compiler.

# Tool

common

@[Target](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-target/index.html)(allowedTargets = [[AnnotationTarget.FUNCTION](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.annotation/-annotation-target/-f-u-n-c-t-i-o-n/index.html)])

annotation class [Tool](index.html)(val name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "", val description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "", val requireConfirmation: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, val isLongRunning: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false)

Annotates a function to be exposed as an executable tool by the Google ADK Kotlin. KSP will generate a corresponding [com.google.adk.kt.tools.FunctionTool](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-function-tool/index.html) wrapper for annotated functions.

The generated wrapper converts the function's return value into a JSON-native [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html): data classes, enums, lists, maps, and nested structures are translated at compile time. A function may therefore return a data class directly, unlike a hand-written [com.google.adk.kt.tools.BaseTool](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-base-tool/index.html), whose result must already be JSON-native.

Note: this annotation shares its simple name with [com.google.adk.kt.types.Tool](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-tool/index.html), the GenAI tool definition data class. Files that need to reference both should use an import alias.

Retained at runtime so the JVM-only `ReflectiveTools` can read it via reflection to build tools from Java methods, which the KSP path cannot process without the Kotlin compiler.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.tools](../index.html)/FunctionTool

# FunctionTool

common

abstract class [FunctionTool](index.html)(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), isLongRunning: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, customMetadata: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)> = emptyMap(), requiresConfirmation: ([Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>) -> [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = { false }) : [BaseTool](../-base-tool/index.html)

Represents a compile-time generated tool that wraps a function annotated with [com.google.adk.kt.annotations.Tool](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-tool/index.html).

The optional confirmation gate (set via the `requiresConfirmation` constructor parameter) makes an invocation pause for human approval before the underlying function runs:

  * On the first call the tool records a confirmation request via [ToolContext.requestConfirmation](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/request-confirmation.html) and returns a placeholder error response without invoking the underlying function.

  * Once the user supplies a [com.google.adk.kt.events.ToolConfirmation](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-tool-confirmation/index.html), the tool is re-executed: if the user confirmed it runs normally; otherwise it returns a rejection error response.




The gate has two forms:

  * Per-call predicate (the primary constructor): a `(args) -> Boolean` is invoked on every call with the function's `args` and decides whether to gate this invocation, e.g. `requiresConfirmation = { args -> (args["amount"] as Int) > 1000 }`. The default value `{ false }` disables the gate entirely.

  * Boolean (the secondary constructor): a constant flag that gates either every invocation (`true`) or none (`false`). It is a thin wrapper that lifts the Boolean into a constant predicate `{ value }`.

constructor(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), isLongRunning: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, customMetadata: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)> = emptyMap(), requiresConfirmation: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html))

Boolean convenience constructor: pass `true` to gate every invocation, `false` to skip the gate entirely. Equivalent to passing `{ requiresConfirmation }` to the primary constructor.

[isLongRunning](../-base-tool/is-long-running.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [isLongRunning](../-base-tool/is-long-running.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Whether the tool's final result will be delivered out-of-band. When `true`, the framework marks the call as long-running and uses the tool's return value as the function-response payload. Returning `Unit` means "no response yet": the FR event is suppressed so the function-call event (which carries the call id in `longRunningToolIds` and is thus the turn's final response) ends the turn without re-invoking the model. A non-`Unit` return -- including an explicit empty `Map` \-- is treated as a real response and emitted. (`Unit` suppression aligns with Python; Java instead always emits `{}`.) The `longRunningToolIds` id also drives the resumable-mode pause gate so the invocation can be resumed later via a user-injected function-response.

## Functions

[asNode](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/as-node.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

@[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html)

# execute

common

abstract suspend fun [execute](execute.html)(context: [ToolContext](../-tool-context/index.html), args: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>): [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)

Executes the function with the provided [args](execute.html), optionally utilizing the [context](execute.html).

#### Return

The tool's response, conventionally a `Map<String, Any>` whose values are JSON-native. Non-map values are wrapped under [BaseTool.RESULT_KEY](../-base-tool/-companion/-r-e-s-u-l-t_-k-e-y.html). Return `mapOf(ERROR_KEY to "<message>")` to signal an LLM-visible error. From a long-running tool, return `Unit` to defer the response; see [BaseTool.isLongRunning](../-base-tool/is-long-running.html).

#### Parameters

 _context_

The current [ToolContext](../-tool-context/index.html).

_args_

The extracted arguments provided by the LLM.

[isLongRunning](is-long-running.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [isLongRunning](is-long-running.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Whether the tool's final result will be delivered out-of-band. When `true`, the framework marks the call as long-running and uses the tool's return value as the function-response payload. Returning `Unit` means "no response yet": the FR event is suppressed so the function-call event (which carries the call id in `longRunningToolIds` and is thus the turn's final response) ends the turn without re-invoking the model. A non-`Unit` return -- including an explicit empty `Map` \-- is treated as a real response and emitted. (`Unit` suppression aligns with Python; Java instead always emits `{}`.) The `longRunningToolIds` id also drives the resumable-mode pause gate so the invocation can be resumed later via a user-injected function-response.

Schema is used to define the format of input/output data.

Represents a select subset of an [OpenAPI 3.0 schema object](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.0.3#schema-object).

[default](default.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [default](default.html): [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?

The value to assume when the property is absent. Must be JSON-native -- a `String`, number, `Boolean`, `Map` or `List` \-- since anything else fails to serialize. Serializing a [Schema](index.html) that sets this needs a `Json` whose `serializersModule` carries a contextual serializer for `Any`; a plain `Json` throws. JSON also has a single number type, so a numeric default that crosses a JSON boundary comes back as whatever Kotlin type the reader picks, not necessarily the one it was written as.

[format](format.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [format](format.html): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)?

The format of the data, refining [type](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/--root--.html). The field is free-form, but Gemini accepts only `int32` or `int64` for [Type.INTEGER](../-type/-i-n-t-e-g-e-r/index.html) and [Type.NUMBER](../-type/-n-u-m-b-e-r/index.html), and `enum` or `date-time` for [Type.STRING](../-type/-s-t-r-i-n-g/index.html); it rejects a declaration carrying any other value.

## Functions

[toBuilder](to-builder.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

fun [toBuilder](to-builder.html)(): [Schema.Builder](-builder/index.html)

Returns a [Builder](-builder/index.html) initialized with this instance's properties, primarily for Java callers. Prefer it over `copy` from Java: `copy` takes every property positionally, so its signature changes whenever a property is added.

[toJsonSchema](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/to-json-schema.html)

Link copied to clipboard

commonJvmAndroid

fun [Schema](index.html).[toJsonSchema](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/to-json-schema.html)(): [JsonObject](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-json/kotlinx.serialization.json/-json-object/index.html)

Renders this [Schema](index.html) as a JSON Schema [JsonObject](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-json/kotlinx.serialization.json/-json-object/index.html), the same shape used in prompt tool descriptions. Exposed so an adapter can hand a tool's parameter schema to another framework rather than forking this conversion.

# toBuilder

common

fun [toBuilder](to-builder.html)(): [Schema.Builder](-builder/index.html)

Returns a [Builder](-builder/index.html) initialized with this instance's properties, primarily for Java callers. Prefer it over `copy` from Java: `copy` takes every property positionally, so its signature changes whenever a property is added.

# PreloadMemoryTool

common

class [PreloadMemoryTool](index.html) : [BaseTool](../-base-tool/index.html)

A tool that preloads the memory for the current user.

This tool will be automatically executed for each llm_request, and it won't be called by the model.

NOTE: Currently this tool only uses text part from the memory.

[isLongRunning](../-base-tool/is-long-running.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [isLongRunning](../-base-tool/is-long-running.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Whether the tool's final result will be delivered out-of-band. When `true`, the framework marks the call as long-running and uses the tool's return value as the function-response payload. Returning `Unit` means "no response yet": the FR event is suppressed so the function-call event (which carries the call id in `longRunningToolIds` and is thus the turn's final response) ends the turn without re-invoking the model. A non-`Unit` return -- including an explicit empty `Map` \-- is treated as a real response and emitted. (`Unit` suppression aligns with Python; Java instead always emits `{}`.) The `longRunningToolIds` id also drives the resumable-mode pause gate so the invocation can be resumed later via a user-injected function-response.

# run

common

open suspend override fun [run](run.html)(context: [ToolContext](../-tool-context/index.html), args: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>): [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)

Executes the tool and returns its result.

The result must be JSON-native: a [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html), [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html), [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), number, [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html), or `null`; a non-[Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html) result is wrapped under [RESULT_KEY](../-base-tool/-companion/-r-e-s-u-l-t_-k-e-y.html), with a regular tool's `Unit` (no result) sent as `null`. Returning a non-JSON type such as a Kotlin data class throws when the resulting event is persisted. To return structured data, return a [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html), or expose the function via [com.google.adk.kt.annotations.Tool](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-tool/index.html), which converts data classes (and enums, lists, and nested structures) into Maps automatically.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# NodeConfig

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

data class [NodeConfig](index.html)(val retryConfig: [RetryConfig](../-retry-config/index.html)? = null, val timeout: [Duration](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.time/-duration/index.html)? = null)

Bundles a node's retry policy and execution timeout. A null [timeout](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node-config/--root--.html) imposes no limit, so an attempt is then bounded only by any ambient deadline. Validation lives here, so every [Node](../-node/index.html) implementation inherits it.

[backoffFactor](backoff-factor.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [backoffFactor](backoff-factor.html): [Double](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-double/index.html)

Multiplier applied to the delay after each attempt.

[exceptions](exceptions.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [exceptions](exceptions.html): [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)>?

Reported type names to retry on, matched exactly with no subclass match. The reported name is the failure's own simple name, or for a [NodeExecutionException](../-node-execution-exception/index.html) the wrapped failure's type name -- so list e.g. "RuntimeError", not "NodeExecutionException". Null retries any failure; an empty list retries none.

Randomness factor, not a duration: the delay is spread over `delay * (1 +/- jitter)`. Zero removes randomness.

The receiver that collects the edges declared in an [edges](edges.html) or [workflow](workflow.html) block. A node is identified by its instance, so create each node once and reuse it. To add a tool as a step, convert it once with [asNode](as-node.html) and reuse that node.

A block that declares edges or routes on a [T](-edges-dsl-block/index.html) builder. In Kotlin, pass a lambda with the builder as its receiver. In Java, pass a lambda that takes the builder as an argument, with no `Unit` to return.

# joinTo

common

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

infix fun [NodeGroup](../-node-group/index.html).[joinTo](join-to.html)(join: [JoinNode](../-join-node/index.html)): [Node](../-node/index.html)

Fans in by connecting each node of this group to [join](join-to.html), which runs once all of them complete. Returns [join](join-to.html) so the chain continues from it: `a.then(b, c).joinTo(join).then(d)`.

Fans in by connecting each node in this collection, such as a computed list, to [join](join-to.html), like `nodes(...).joinTo(join)`. Returns [join](join-to.html) so the chain continues from it. An empty collection adds no edges.

# EdgesBuilder

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

class [EdgesBuilder](index.html)

The receiver that collects the edges declared in an [edges](../edges.html) or [workflow](../workflow.html) block. A node is identified by its instance, so create each node once and reuse it. To add a tool as a step, convert it once with [asNode](../as-node.html) and reuse that node.

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

fun [chain](chain.html)(first: [Node](../-node/index.html), second: [Node](../-node/index.html), vararg rest: [Node](../-node/index.html)): [Node](../-node/index.html)

Connects [first](chain.html), [second](chain.html), and each node in [rest](chain.html) in order by adding an edge from each node to the next. Returns the last node so the chain can continue from it: `chain(Start, a, b)` is short for `Start.then(a).then(b)`.

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

fun [Node](../-node/index.html).[chain](chain.html)(first: [Node](../-node/index.html), second: [Node](../-node/index.html), vararg rest: [Node](../-node/index.html)): [Node](../-node/index.html)

Connects this node to [first](chain.html), [second](chain.html), and each node in [rest](chain.html) in order by adding an edge from each node to the next, and returns the last node. `a.chain(b, c)` is short for `a.then(b).then(c)`. Unlike the `chain` overload that takes the first node as an argument, this form can continue a fluent chain, such as after [joinTo](join-to.html).

[nodes](nodes.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

fun [nodes](nodes.html)(vararg nodes: [Node](../-node/index.html)): [NodeGroup](../-node-group/index.html)

Groups [nodes](nodes.html) without connecting them, as in `a then nodes(b, c)` for an infix fan-out or `nodes(b, c).joinTo(join)` for a join. Prefer this over `listOf(b, c)` for fan-outs and joins because `listOf` infers the nodes' closest common supertype. For some built-in nodes of different types, such as a [Workflow](../-workflow/index.html) and a [JoinNode](../-join-node/index.html), that supertype is the framework-internal `BaseNode`, so the call fails to compile.

common

infix fun [Node](../-node/index.html).[route](route.html)(block: [EdgesDslBlock](../-edges-dsl-block/index.html)<[RouteMapBuilder](../-route-map-builder/index.html)>)

Adds this node's routing map, with an edge for each route [block](route.html) maps to a node. A routing map ends the statement; connect its targets onward in separate statements. An empty map throws [IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html), and an entry not completed with `then` throws [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html).

Fans out to each node in [targets](then.html) so they run concurrently, as in `a then nodes(b, c)`. Returns [targets](then.html), which [joinTo](join-to.html) connects to a [JoinNode](../-join-node/index.html) to continue once they all complete.

Fans out by connecting this node to [first](then.html), [second](then.html), and each node in [rest](then.html) so they run concurrently, as in `a.then(b, c)`. # chain

common

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

fun [chain](chain.html)(first: [Node](../-node/index.html), second: [Node](../-node/index.html), vararg rest: [Node](../-node/index.html)): [Node](../-node/index.html)

Connects [first](chain.html), [second](chain.html), and each node in [rest](chain.html) in order by adding an edge from each node to the next. Returns the last node so the chain can continue from it: `chain(Start, a, b)` is short for `Start.then(a).then(b)`.

* * *

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

fun [Node](../-node/index.html).[chain](chain.html)(first: [Node](../-node/index.html), second: [Node](../-node/index.html), vararg rest: [Node](../-node/index.html)): [Node](../-node/index.html)

Connects this node to [first](chain.html), [second](chain.html), and each node in [rest](chain.html) in order by adding an edge from each node to the next, and returns the last node. `a.chain(b, c)` is short for `a.then(b).then(c)`. Unlike the `chain` overload that takes the first node as an argument, this form can continue a fluent chain, such as after [joinTo](join-to.html).

# Node

common

interface [Node](index.html)

A unit of work in a workflow graph.

Node names must be unique within a graph, since the scheduler keys on them.

Every member except [name](name.html) and [description](description.html) requires opting in to [ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html), so implementing a node does too; those two need no opt-in because `App`, `Runner` and `InvocationContext` expose a node as stable API.

# runNode

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

abstract fun [runNode](run-node.html)(context: [Context](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/index.html), nodeInput: [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?): [Flow](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.coroutines/kotlinx-coroutines-core/kotlinx.coroutines.flow/-flow/index.html)<[Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?>

The user-facing implementation of the node's execution logic.

Emits any of:

  * A raw output value (e.g. String, Int, a data class, List, Map), which becomes this node's output and is normalized into an [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) by the engine.

  * A [RequestInput](../-request-input/index.html), which the engine normalizes into an `adk_request_input` interrupt event that pauses the graph until the user answers.

  * An [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html), which passes through directly (useful for progress emissions or custom events).

  * `null` or [Unit](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unit/index.html), both of which signify that no output was produced. [Unit](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-unit/index.html) represents side-effecting Kotlin lambdas/functions that return no value, while `null` represents the explicit absence of an output.




Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

[isFinalResponse](is-final-response.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [isFinalResponse](is-final-response.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

Returns true if this event is the final response of an agent turn — i.e. it terminates the per-turn model loop in [com.google.adk.kt.agents.LlmAgent.executeTurns](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.agents/-llm-agent/execute-turns.html). Matches ADK Python's `Event.is_final_response()`: `skipSummarization` or a non-empty `longRunningToolIds` set both mark the event as final, otherwise the event is final iff it carries no function calls, no function responses, is not a partial streaming chunk, and has no trailing code-execution-result part.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.events](../index.html)/EventCompaction

# EventCompaction

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [EventCompaction](index.html)(val startTimestamp: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html), val endTimestamp: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html), val compactedContent: [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html))

A record that a continuous range of session [Event](../-event/index.html)s has been replaced by a single piece of [compactedContent](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-compaction/--root--.html) (typically a model-generated summary).

An [EventCompaction](index.html) is attached to a new [Event](../-event/index.html) via [EventActions.compaction](../-event-actions/compaction.html); the original events are left untouched. When the next LLM prompt is built, the contents processor uses the range to skip the covered events and inserts [compactedContent](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-compaction/--root--.html) in their place.

Members

## Constructors

[EventCompaction](-event-compaction.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

## Properties

[compactedContent](compacted-content.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [compactedContent](compacted-content.html): [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html)

The content that replaces the covered events in the prompt.

[endTimestamp](end-timestamp.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)(with = [LenientEpochMillisSerializer::class](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.serialization/-lenient-epoch-millis-serializer/index.html))

val [endTimestamp](end-timestamp.html): [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)

Epoch milliseconds of the latest covered event (inclusive). Must be greater than or equal to [startTimestamp](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-compaction/--root--.html). Also reads ADK Python's fractional epoch seconds.

[startTimestamp](start-timestamp.html)

[endOfAgent](end-of-agent.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

var [endOfAgent](end-of-agent.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)

If true, the current agent has finished its current run. Note that there can be multiple events with [endOfAgent](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/--root--.html) set to `true` for the same agent within one invocation when there is a loop. The ADK workflow sets this when an agent's run completes naturally. In addition, tools and callbacks may set this on an event they produce to request the current LLM agent's per-step loop to stop after the current step, mirroring Java ADK's `EventActions.setEndInvocation(true)` / `setEndOfAgent(true)`. Note: this only stops the current LLM agent's step loop; it does not terminate an enclosing workflow agent (`SequentialAgent`, `LoopAgent`, `ParallelAgent`). To break out of a `LoopAgent`, set [escalate](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/--root--.html) instead. `CallbackContext.endInvocation()` / `ToolContext.endInvocation()` are convenience helpers for the same per-agent stop signal via [InvocationContext.isEndOfInvocation](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-invocation-context/is-end-of-invocation.html).

# Route

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)(with = [RouteSerializer::class](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-route-serializer/index.html))

sealed interface [Route](index.html)

A value on a workflow edge, and the value a node emits to select which of its outgoing edges are followed. An edge fires when the value it carries matches one the node emitted.

On the wire a route is a bare scalar - a string, integer or boolean - and [Default](-default/index.html) is the [DEFAULT_ROUTE_SENTINEL](-companion/-d-e-f-a-u-l-t_-r-o-u-t-e_-s-e-n-t-i-n-e-l.html) string, matching adk-python.

#### Inheritors

[Tag](-tag/index.html)

[Num](-num/index.html)

[Flag](-flag/index.html)

[Default](-default/index.html)

Members

## Types

[Companion](-companion/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

object [Companion](-companion/index.html)

[Default](-default/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

data object [Default](-default/index.html) : [Route](index.html)

The fallback edge, followed when no other routed edge of the node matches what it emitted, including when it emitted no route. A node may declare several, which all fire together, but a default cannot share an edge with a concrete route.

[Flag](-flag/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

data class [Flag](-flag/index.html)(val value: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)) : [Route](index.html)

A route identified by a boolean, for a two-way branch.

[Num](-num/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

data class [Num](-num/index.html)(val value: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)) : [Route](index.html)

A route identified by an integer.

[Tag](-tag/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

data class [Tag](-tag/index.html)(val value: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)) : [Route](index.html)

A route identified by a string, the common case. Throws [IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html) for [DEFAULT_ROUTE_SENTINEL](-companion/-d-e-f-a-u-l-t_-r-o-u-t-e_-s-e-n-t-i-n-e-l.html), which would read back from JSON as [Default](-default/index.html).

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# Default

common

data object [Default](index.html) : [Route](../index.html)

The fallback edge, followed when no other routed edge of the node matches what it emitted, including when it emitted no route. A node may declare several, which all fire together, but a default cannot share an edge with a concrete route.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# removeTempKeys

common

fun [removeTempKeys](remove-temp-keys.html)()

Deletes the `temp:`-prefixed entries from [stateDelta](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/--root--.html) in place, so they are never persisted.

Unlike [removeStateByKey](remove-state-by-key.html), which marks a key with [State.REMOVED](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/-companion/-r-e-m-o-v-e-d.html), this drops the entries outright; the live session still receives `temp:` values via [State.applyTempDelta](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/apply-temp-delta.html).

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# State

common

class [State](index.html)(initialState: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)> = emptyMap(), initialDelta: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)> = emptyMap()) : [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)>

A thread-safe state map that maintains the current value and tracks modifications.

This class implements [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html) to provide a read-only view of the state, while exposing specific mutation methods ([set](set.html), [putAll](put-all.html)).

# VertexAiSessionService

jvm

class [VertexAiSessionService](index.html) : [SessionService](../-session-service/index.html)

A [SessionService](../-session-service/index.html) backed by the managed Vertex AI Session Service.

This is a Kotlin port of the Java ADK `com.google.adk.sessions.VertexAiSessionService`. It talks to the service through a [VertexAiSessionsClient](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-vertex-ai-sessions-client/index.html) over a shared GoogleApiClient. The wire format (defined by `session.proto`) is modeled with a small set of `@Serializable` DTOs in the `dto` sub-package; this class only translates between those DTOs and the ADK domain types via the mapper extensions in `com.google.adk.kt.sessions.dto.SessionMappers`.

The reasoning engine is fixed at construction from [project](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-vertex-ai-session-service/--root--.html), [location](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-vertex-ai-session-service/--root--.html), and [reasoningEngineId](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-vertex-ai-session-service/--root--.html). Unlike the Python and Java ADK, the session key's [SessionKey.appName](../-session-key/app-name.html) is never parsed to derive the engine - it is only a label - so the engine must be supplied explicitly here.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.sessions](../index.html)/[SessionService](index.html)/appendEvent

# appendEvent

common

open suspend fun [appendEvent](append-event.html)(session: [Session](../-session/index.html), event: [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)): [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)

Appends [event](append-event.html) to [session](append-event.html), applying its state delta to the in-memory session and recording the event; `temp:` keys are applied to the in-memory state (so later agents in the invocation can read them) but removed from [event](append-event.html) before persistence.

Overriding implementations must run this lifecycle before persisting so the stored event has no `temp:` keys: call `super.appendEvent` first then persist the trimmed [event](append-event.html), or call [State.applyTempDelta](../-state/apply-temp-delta.html) and [com.google.adk.kt.events.EventActions.removeTempKeys](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/remove-temp-keys.html) before persisting with `super.appendEvent` last (needed when a stale-write check must read the pre-update [Session.lastUpdateTime](../-session/last-update-time.html)).

Overrides must also return early when [Event.partial](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/partial.html) is true, before running this lifecycle: `super.appendEvent` skips partials without trimming `temp:` keys, so persisting after `super` would store an untrimmed partial event.

#### Return

The appended [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html), or the original unchanged if it was partial.

#### Parameters

 _session_

The [Session](../-session/index.html) to update in place.

_event_

The [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) to append; its `temp:` state-delta keys are removed in place.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# flush

common

open suspend fun [flush](flush.html)(key: [SessionKey](../-session-key/index.html)? = null)

Waits until the writes appended before this call are persisted: those to [key](flush.html), or to every session when [key](flush.html) is `null`. Canceling the caller stops the wait, not the writes.

The default does nothing, which suits a service that persists each write before returning; a service that buffers writes overrides it, and a service that wraps another passes it on.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The session to flush, or `null` for every session. A non-null key needs a non-null [SessionKey.id](../-session-key/id.html).

#### Throws

[SessionException](../-session-exception/index.html)

if a buffered write could not be persisted.

[google-adk-kotlin-core](../../index.html)/[com.google.adk.kt.agents](../index.html)/[Context](index.html)/runNode

# runNode

common

@[CanIgnoreReturnValue](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.errorprone/error_prone_annotations/latest/com/google/errorprone/annotations/CanIgnoreReturnValue.html)

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

suspend fun [runNode](run-node.html)(node: [Node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/index.html), nodeInput: [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)? = null, runId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, useAsOutput: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, useSubBranch: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, overrideBranch: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, raiseOnWait: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false): [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)?

Executes [node](run-node.html) as a child of this node activation and returns its output.

Child events are recorded under `<thisNodePath>/<node.name>@<runId>`. If [node](run-node.html) fails, this call throws [DynamicNodeFailedException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-dynamic-node-failed-exception/index.html), which fails this node unless the caller catches it. If [node](run-node.html) pauses for input, this call throws an internal [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html) that is not an [Exception](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-exception/index.html), so the runtime can mark this node as waiting; do not catch it with `runCatching` or `catch (t: Throwable)`.

#### Parameters

 _node_

Child node to execute.

_node Input_

Input passed to [node](run-node.html), or `null` if none.

_run Id_

Explicit run ID for [node](run-node.html): at least one non-digit, and no `'/'`, `'@'`, or `'.'`. A child that finished in an earlier turn under the same ID returns its recorded output without running again. When `null` or empty, the child gets the next number for its name, which follows call order, so concurrent children need explicit IDs.

_use AsOutput_

When `true`, delegates this node's output to [node](run-node.html): this node must not produce an output of its own afterwards, even if [node](run-node.html) finishes without one. The claim is released only if [node](run-node.html) fails before emitting an output, so a caller that catches the failure may fall back to its own output. Once [node](run-node.html) has emitted, its output is this node's output and successors receive it.

_use SubBranch_

When `true`, runs [node](run-node.html) on a sub-branch `<branch>.<node.name>@<runId>`.

_override Branch_

Branch for [node](run-node.html) to run on instead of this node's branch.

_raise OnWait_

When `true` and [node](run-node.html) is a [Workflow](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-workflow/index.html) or sets [Node.waitForOutput](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/wait-for-output.html) but finishes without an output, aborts this node's run like an interrupt, without recording one: this node completes with any output it already produced, or else waits only if it sets [Node.waitForOutput](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/wait-for-output.html).

#### Throws

[IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html)

if called outside a node activation, if this node does not set `rerunOnResume = true`, or if this node already produced or delegated its output and [useAsOutput](run-node.html) is `true`.

[IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html)

if [node](run-node.html)'s name or [runId](run-node.html) is invalid, or if [nodeInput](run-node.html) fails [node](run-node.html)'s input schema. A [node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/node.html) child's input check throws [NodeInputValidationException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node-input-validation-exception/index.html) instead.

[DynamicNodeFailedException](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-dynamic-node-failed-exception/index.html)

if [node](run-node.html) fails; its `error` is the child's failure.

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

inline fun <[I](node.html), [O](node.html)> [node](node.html)(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "", rerunOnResume: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, waitForOutput: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, config: [NodeConfig](-node-config/index.html) = NodeConfig(), inputSchema: [Schema](../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, outputSchema: [Schema](../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, stateSchema: [Schema](../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, crossinline block: suspend [FlowCollector](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.coroutines/kotlinx-coroutines-core/kotlinx.coroutines.flow/-flow-collector/index.html)<[Event](../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)>.(context: [Context](../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context/index.html), input: [I](node.html)) -> [O](node.html)): [FunctionNode](-function-node/index.html)<[I](node.html), [O](node.html)>

Creates a [FunctionNode](-function-node/index.html) that runs [block](node.html) on an input of type [I](node.html) and returns an output of type [O](node.html), emitting progress [Event](../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)s through its [FlowCollector](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.coroutines/kotlinx-coroutines-core/kotlinx.coroutines.flow/-flow-collector/index.html) receiver. Schemas inferred from [I](node.html) and [O](node.html) describe the node, while an explicit [inputSchema](node.html) or [outputSchema](node.html) is also enforced on every run.

# FunctionNode

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

class [FunctionNode](index.html)<[I](index.html), [O](index.html)> : [BaseNode](../-base-node/index.html)

A workflow [Node](../-node/index.html) backed by a suspending function that may emit progress [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)s and returns an output of type [O](index.html). Its schemas inferred from [I](index.html) and [O](index.html) only describe it; an explicit schema passed to [node](../node.html) is also enforced.

Inline workflow steps use [node](../node.html) or [parallelNode](../parallel-node.html).

#### Type Parameters

 _I_

Expected type of `nodeInput` from predecessor nodes.

_O_

Type of output value this node returns (`Unit`/`null` emits no output event; [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) passes through directly; a [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html) becomes a message event with no node output; any other value becomes the node's output on an [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)).

# BaseNode

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

abstract class [BaseNode](index.html)(val name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "", val rerunOnResume: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, val waitForOutput: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, val config: [NodeConfig](../-node-config/index.html) = NodeConfig(), val inputSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, val outputSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, val stateSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null) : [Node](../-node/index.html)

The base class for units of work in a workflow graph. A `Workflow` is itself a node, so graphs nest, and every agent is one too.

Public only so that `BaseAgent`, `Workflow`, `JoinNode` and the Java interop base `BasePublisherNode` can extend it. It is framework plumbing: write a node by implementing [Node](../-node/index.html), or from Java by extending `BasePublisherNode`.

Subclasses implement [runNode](../-node/run-node.html) and emit raw values; [run](run.html) normalizes each into an [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html). Node names must be unique within a graph, since the scheduler keys on them.

#### Inheritors

[BasePublisherNode](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.interop/-base-publisher-node/index.html)

[BaseAgent](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-base-agent/index.html)

[FunctionNode](../-function-node/index.html)

[JoinNode](../-join-node/index.html)

[Workflow](../-workflow/index.html)

# BasePublisherNode

commonJvmAndroid

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

abstract class [BasePublisherNode](index.html) @[JvmOverloads](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.jvm/-jvm-overloads/index.html) constructor(name: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), description: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "", rerunOnResume: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, waitForOutput: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, config: [NodeConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node-config/index.html) = NodeConfig(), inputSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, outputSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null, stateSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null) : [BaseNode](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-base-node/index.html)

Java-friendly base for implementing a workflow node. A Java subclass overrides [runNodeJava](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.interop/-base-publisher-node/run-node-java.html) to set routes or state on the context and return a Reactive Streams [Publisher](https://www.reactive-streams.org/reactive-streams-1.0.4-javadoc/org/reactivestreams/Publisher.html) of node outputs, which this base adapts to the `Flow`-returning [runNode](run-node.html).
