# RequestInput

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

data class [RequestInput](index.html)(val interruptId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = Uuid.random(), val message: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val payload: [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)? = null, val responseSchema: [Schema](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-schema/index.html)? = null)

A node's request for user input, which pauses the workflow until a matching response arrives.

Normalized into a long-running `adk_request_input` function call; the response is a [com.google.adk.kt.types.FunctionResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-function-response/index.html) with matching [interruptId](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-request-input/--root--.html).

[BaseFutureLiveConnection](-base-future-live-connection/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

commonJvmAndroid

@[ExperimentalLiveApi](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-live-api/index.html)

abstract class [BaseFutureLiveConnection](-base-future-live-connection/index.html) : [LiveConnection](../com.google.adk.kt.models/-live-connection/index.html)

Java-friendly base for implementing a [LiveConnection](../com.google.adk.kt.models/-live-connection/index.html): override the `...Async` methods, which return a [CompletableFuture](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/util/concurrent/CompletableFuture.html), and [receiveJava](../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.interop/-base-future-live-connection/receive-java.html), which returns a [Publisher](https://www.reactive-streams.org/reactive-streams-1.0.4-javadoc/org/reactivestreams/Publisher.html) of one model turn. The base maps these to [LiveConnection](../com.google.adk.kt.models/-live-connection/index.html)'s calls and also enforces two of its rules, one [receive](-base-future-live-connection/receive.html) collector at a time and a [closeSession](-base-future-live-connection/close-session.html) that is safe to call again; apply its content rules yourself. Return a new future from each call, because the base cancels a send's future when its caller is cancelled, and a new publisher from each [receiveJava](../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.interop/-base-future-live-connection/receive-java.html) call; return each promptly, with any blocking work inside it, and fail a future rather than cancel it.

[BaseFuturePlugin](-base-future-plugin/index.html)

abstract class [BaseFuturePlugin](-base-future-plugin/index.html)(pluginName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)) : [Plugin](../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin/index.html)

Java-friendly base for implementing a [Plugin](../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin/index.html) \-- the cross-cutting interception point. The engine's `Plugin` has 13 `suspend` callbacks plus `close()`, every one with a default body. This base final-overrides all 13 and re-exposes each as a [CompletableFuture](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/util/concurrent/CompletableFuture.html)-returning hook whose _result_ is the outcome; each default hook completes with the value that leaves execution unchanged. Return the future promptly and do any blocking work inside it, not before returning it.

[PublisherRunner](-publisher-runner/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

commonJvmAndroid

class [PublisherRunner](-publisher-runner/index.html) : [AutoCloseable](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/lang/AutoCloseable.html)

Java-friendly wrapper around a [Runner](../com.google.adk.kt.runners/-runner/index.html). A run is exposed as a Reactive Streams [Publisher](https://www.reactive-streams.org/reactive-streams-1.0.4-javadoc/org/reactivestreams/Publisher.html) of events, so Java callers never touch `Flow`; collect it with `AsyncJavaHelpers.collect`/`forEach` or any Reactive Streams consumer. Session management is not a runner concern -- reach the session service via `asKotlinRunner().sessionService` (or wrap it in a `BaseFutureSessionService`).

[ReflectiveTools](-reflective-tools/index.html)

Link copied to clipboard

jvm

object [ReflectiveTools](-reflective-tools/index.html)

Builds a [BaseTool](../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-base-tool/index.html) from a [Tool](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-tool/index.html)-annotated Java method, the reflective counterpart of the engine's KSP `@Tool` path (which needs the Kotlin compiler and so is closed to a javac-only build). It reads the same [Tool](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-tool/index.html)/[Param](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-param/index.html) annotations, relying on [Param.name](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-param/name.html)/[Param.required](../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-param/required.html) because Java retains neither parameter names nor nullability. JVM-only and intended for javac-only modules; prefer the KSP `@Tool` path whenever the code is built with the Kotlin compiler, which processes `.java` sources too.

# flush

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [flush](flush.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html)? = null)

Waits until the writes appended before this call are persisted: those to [key](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/flush.html), or to every session when [key](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/flush.html) is `null`. Canceling the caller stops the wait, not the writes.

The default does nothing, which suits a service that persists each write before returning; a service that buffers writes overrides it, and a service that wraps another passes it on.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The session to flush, or `null` for every session. A non-null key needs a non-null [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html).

#### Throws

[SessionException](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/index.html)

if a buffered write could not be persisted.

# BaseFutureSessionService

commonJvmAndroid

abstract class [BaseFutureSessionService](index.html) : [SessionService](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/index.html)

Java-friendly base for implementing a [SessionService](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/index.html). Every method of the engine interface is `suspend`; this base final-overrides each and asks the Java subclass for a [CompletableFuture](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/util/concurrent/CompletableFuture.html) instead. Return each future promptly and do any blocking work inside it, not before returning it. The methods with default bodies ([closeSession](close-session.html), [appendEvent](append-event.html), [flush](flush.html)) keep those defaults reachable: leave the hook unoverridden and the engine's own behaviour runs.

[appendEvent](append-event.html)

Link copied to clipboard

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [appendEvent](append-event.html)(session: [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html), event: [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)): [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)

Appends [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) to [session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html), applying its state delta to the in-memory session and recording the event; `temp:` keys are applied to the in-memory state (so later agents in the invocation can read them) but removed from [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) before persistence.

# appendEvent

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [appendEvent](append-event.html)(session: [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html), event: [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)): [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)

Appends [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) to [session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html), applying its state delta to the in-memory session and recording the event; `temp:` keys are applied to the in-memory state (so later agents in the invocation can read them) but removed from [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) before persistence.

Overriding implementations must run this lifecycle before persisting so the stored event has no `temp:` keys: call `super.appendEvent` first then persist the trimmed [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html), or call [State.applyTempDelta](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/apply-temp-delta.html) and [com.google.adk.kt.events.EventActions.removeTempKeys](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/remove-temp-keys.html) before persisting with `super.appendEvent` last (needed when a stale-write check must read the pre-update [Session.lastUpdateTime](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/last-update-time.html)).

Overrides must also return early when [Event.partial](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/partial.html) is true, before running this lifecycle: `super.appendEvent` skips partials without trimming `temp:` keys, so persisting after `super` would store an untrimmed partial event.

#### Return

The appended [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html), or the original unchanged if it was partial.

#### Parameters

 _session_

The [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) to update in place.

_event_

The [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) to append; its `temp:` state-delta keys are removed in place.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

© 2026 Copyright

# getSession

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [getSession](get-session.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html), config: [GetSessionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-get-session-config/index.html)? = null): [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html)?

Retrieves a specific session, optionally filtering the events included.

#### Return

The [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) if found, otherwise null.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The composite identifier of the session to retrieve. [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) must not be null.

_config_

Optional configuration to filter the events returned within the session.

# createSession

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [createSession](create-session.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html), state: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)>? = null): [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html)

Creates a new session with the specified parameters.

#### Return

The newly created [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) instance.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The composite identifier of the session. If [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) is null, the service generates a unique session id and the returned [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) will reflect it.

_state_

An optional map representing the initial state of the session.

#### Throws

[SessionException](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/index.html)

with [SessionException.SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/-companion/-s-e-s-s-i-o-n_-a-l-r-e-a-d-y_-e-x-i-s-t-s.html) if a session already exists under [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) for this app and user. An existing session is never overwritten. A service backed by a managed remote store may surface that backend's own error instead.

Generated by  [ Dokka ](https://github.com/Kotlin/dokka)

# CallbackContext

common

class [CallbackContext](index.html)(invocationContext: [InvocationContext](../-invocation-context/index.html), eventActions: [EventActions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html)? = null) : [Context](../-context/index.html)

Context passed to agent and model callbacks.

This subclass is kept for backward compatibility. Prefer [Context](../-context/index.html) in new code.

A callback context is not a node activation, so the node-only members inherited from [Context](../-context/index.html) (such as [Context.output](../-context/output.html) and [Context.routes](../-context/routes.html)) throw [IllegalStateException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-state-exception/index.html) here.

# InvocationContext

common

data class [InvocationContext](index.html)(val session: [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html), val runConfig: [RunConfig](../-run-config/index.html)? = null, val agent: [BaseAgent](../-base-agent/index.html), val branch: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val invocationId: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = "e-" + Uuid.random(), val artifactService: [ArtifactService](../../com.google.adk.kt.artifacts/-artifact-service/index.html)? = null, val memoryService: [MemoryService](../../com.google.adk.kt.memory/-memory-service/index.html)? = null, val sessionService: [SessionService](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/index.html)? = null, val resumabilityConfig: [ResumabilityConfig](../-resumability-config/index.html)? = null, val eventsCompactionConfig: [EventsCompactionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/index.html)? = null, val contextCacheConfig: [ContextCacheConfig](../-context-cache-config/index.html)? = null, val userContent: [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html)? = null, val agentStates: [MutableMap](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-mutable-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [TypedData](../-typed-data/index.html)> = concurrentMutableMapOf(), val endOfAgents: [MutableMap](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-mutable-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)> = concurrentMutableMapOf(), val extraTools: [MutableMap](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-mutable-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [BaseTool](../../com.google.adk.kt.tools/-base-tool/index.html)> = concurrentMutableMapOf(), val frameworkData: [ContextFrameworkData](../-context-framework-data/index.html) = ContextFrameworkData(), var isEndOfInvocation: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false, val pluginManager: [PluginManager](../../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin-manager/index.html) = PluginManager(), invocationCostManager: [InvocationCostManager](../-invocation-cost-manager/index.html) = InvocationCostManager(), val node: [Node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/index.html)? = null)

An invocation context represents the data of a single invocation of an agent.

An invocation:

  1. Starts with a user message and ends with a final response.

  2. Can contain one or multiple agent calls.

  3. Is handled by runner.run_async().




An invocation runs an agent until it does not request to transfer to another agent.

An agent call:

  1. Is handled by agent.run().

  2. Ends when agent.run() ends.




An LLM agent call is an agent with a BaseLLMFlow. An LLM agent call can contain one or multiple steps.

An LLM agent runs steps in a loop until:

  1. A final response is generated.

  2. The agent transfers to another agent.

  3. The end_invocation is set to true by any callbacks or tools.




A step:

  1. Calls the LLM only once and yields its response.

  2. Calls the tools and yields their responses if requested.




The summarization of the function response is considered another step, since it is another llm call. A step ends when it's done calling llm and tools, or if the end_invocation is set to true at any time.
    
    
        ┌─────────────────────── invocation ──────────────────────────┐  
        ┌──────────── llm_agent_call_1 ────────────┐ ┌─ agent_call_2 ─┐  
        ┌──── step_1 ────────┐ ┌───── step_2 ──────┐  
        [call_llm] [call_tool] [call_llm] [transfer]

# App

common

data class [App](index.html)(val appName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), val rootAgent: [BaseAgent](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-base-agent/index.html), val plugins: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[Plugin](../../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin/index.html)> = emptyList(), val resumabilityConfig: [ResumabilityConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-resumability-config/index.html)? = null, val eventsCompactionConfig: [EventsCompactionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/index.html)? = null, val contextCacheConfig: [ContextCacheConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context-cache-config/index.html)? = null, val rootNode: [Node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/index.html)? = null)

Represents an LLM-backed agentic application.

An [App](index.html) is the top-level container for an agentic system powered by LLMs. It bundles an application name together with the [rootAgent](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) that serves as the root of the agent tree, enabling coordination and communication across all agents in the hierarchy. It also carries application-wide configuration, such as [plugins](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) and [resumabilityConfig](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html), that the runner applies to every session it runs.

[appName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) must start with a letter and may contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, and must not be the reserved value `"user"`, which is reserved for end-user input. Construction throws [IllegalArgumentException](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-illegal-argument-exception/index.html) if [appName](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) does not meet these requirements.

The 1.1.0 constructor, which had no [rootNode](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html). Stays visible because javac skips hidden constructors, so Java code written against 1.1.0 would otherwise bind to the node-rooted one.

constructor(appName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), rootNode: [Node](../../com.google.adk.kt.workflow/-node/index.html), plugins: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[Plugin](../../com.google.adk.kt.plugins/-plugin/index.html)> = emptyList(), resumabilityConfig: [ResumabilityConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-resumability-config/index.html)? = null, eventsCompactionConfig: [EventsCompactionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/index.html)? = null, contextCacheConfig: [ContextCacheConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-context-cache-config/index.html)? = null)

Creates an app rooted on a node graph rather than an agent tree. Wraps [rootNode](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) in a NodeViewAgent so the future-deprecated [rootAgent](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.apps/-app/--root--.html) stays non-null during the deprecation window.

val [compactionInterval](compaction-interval.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)?

The number of _new_ user-initiated invocations that, once fully represented in the session's events, will trigger a sliding-window compaction. Must be strictly positive when set.

[eventRetentionSize](event-retention-size.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [eventRetentionSize](event-retention-size.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)?

The number of most recent events kept raw (un-compacted) when token-threshold compaction fires; the older events are summarized into a single event. Must be non-negative when set, and must be set together with [tokenThreshold](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/--root--.html).

[overlapSize](overlap-size.html)

Link copied to clipboard

common

val [overlapSize](overlap-size.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)?

The number of preceding invocations to include from the end of the last compacted range when forming the next sliding-window compaction window. Creates an overlap between consecutive summaries for context continuity. Must be non-negative when set.

[summarizer](summarizer.html)

Link copied to clipboard

val [summarizer](summarizer.html): [EventSummarizer](../-event-summarizer/index.html)?

The [EventSummarizer](../-event-summarizer/index.html) used to produce the compaction summary. When `null`, the runner defaults it to an [LlmEventSummarizer](../-llm-event-summarizer/index.html) backed by the root agent's model, requiring the root to be an `LlmAgent` (otherwise it throws at construction).

val [tokenThreshold](token-threshold.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)?

The most recent prompt token count that triggers intra-invocation token-threshold (tail-retention) compaction before an LLM call. Must be strictly positive when set, and must be set together with [eventRetentionSize](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-events-compaction-config/--root--.html).

# SlidingWindowEventCompactor

common

class [SlidingWindowEventCompactor](index.html)(config: [EventsCompactionConfig](../-events-compaction-config/index.html)) : [EventCompactor](../-event-compactor/index.html)

An [EventCompactor](../-event-compactor/index.html) that compacts events in a sliding window over invocations.

Every `compactionInterval` new user-initiated invocations triggers a compaction over a window spanning the new invocations plus `overlapSize` preceding invocations from the prior compaction boundary. The overlap preserves context continuity across consecutive summaries.

## Safety net

Before summarizing, the selected window is shrunk to its longest self-contained prefix so a compaction never splits an open interaction. Both a function call and a human-in-the-loop tool-confirmation request open an obligation keyed by the call ID, and a function response with the same ID closes it. The window is cut back to the last point where no obligation is still open, which guarantees:

  * no function call is summarized without its response,

  * no tool-confirmation request (`event.actions.requestedToolConfirmations`) without its resolving response.




A summarizer failure skips the compaction instead of failing the caller, since the uncompacted history is still usable.

# TokenThresholdEventCompactor

common

class [TokenThresholdEventCompactor](index.html)(config: [EventsCompactionConfig](../-events-compaction-config/index.html), agentName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), branch: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)?) : [EventCompactor](../-event-compactor/index.html)

An [EventCompactor](../-event-compactor/index.html) that compacts events once the most recent prompt reaches a token threshold, keeping a tail of recent events raw (tail retention).

It is intended to run intra-invocation, before each model call: when the most recently observed prompt token count reaches `tokenThreshold`, every event older than the last `eventRetentionSize` events (since the previous compaction) is summarized into a single event, while the most recent events are preserved raw to maintain continuity.

## Safety net

The window never strands an open interaction: the window is shrunk to its [longestSelfContainedPrefix](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/index.html). A summarizer failure skips the compaction instead of failing the caller, since the uncompacted history is still usable.

#### Parameters

 _config_

The compaction configuration; must have token-threshold fields set.

_agent Name_

The current agent name, used when estimating the prompt token count.

_branch_

The current invocation branch, used when estimating the prompt token count.

# LlmEventSummarizer

common

class [LlmEventSummarizer](index.html)(val model: [Model](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-model/index.html), val promptTemplate: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html) = DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE) : [EventSummarizer](../-event-summarizer/index.html)

An LLM-based event summarizer for context compaction.

This class is responsible for summarizing a provided list of events into a single compacted event. It is designed to be used as part of a context-compaction process such as sliding-window or tail-retention compaction.

When [summarizeEvents](summarize-events.html) is called with a list of events, this class formats the events, generates a summary using the [model](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.summarizer/-llm-event-summarizer/--root--.html), and returns a new [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) containing the summary within a [com.google.adk.kt.events.EventCompaction](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-compaction/index.html) on its [Event.actions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/actions.html).
